Chapter 887: Chapter 23: Renowned Across The Universe (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 887: Chapter 23: Renowned Across the Universe (Please Subscribe)

The Myriad Transformation Queen decisively chose to withdraw upon seeing that the Galaxy Master had already reached the level of ‘undefeatable without taking action.’

Not withdrawing would only mean a futile depletion of her race’s reserves.

To this point, for this massive battlefield war, the Insect Race had already paid enough.

Nearly a hundred supreme weapons, the many Level Eleven clones, and the life essence required to maintain balance, which is equivalent to one-tenth life essence of ten Level Eleven Perfects.

How long and how much effort and resources it would take to recover, one cannot know.

Though it is said, as long as the Insect Race’s Queens are unharmed, the Insect Race stands firm like Mount Tai.

But if there is a generational gap at the Level Eleven, for the next hundred billion to a trillion years,

It’s possible that the Insect Race will not be able to produce a new Level Twelve Queen.

While other peak races will not stand still, perhaps giving birth to one or more Level Twelve ultimates.

If the number of Level Twelve beings in other races increases while if one’s own does not, it would be equivalent to weakening.

Over the long term, the Insect Race’s position among the Twelve Pinnacle Races will decline.

As for the price to pay for admitting defeat?

Merely one ten-thousandth of their own territory, which the Insect Race can still afford.

…

“This Galaxy Master is extremely powerful in all aspects, far surpassing the limit of Level Eleven Perfect. How did he achieve this? Could it be related to that ultimate opportunity obtained by the Human Civilization Alliance?”

The Myriad Transformation Queen observed Lin Yuan from afar, wishing to glimpse some secrets, unfortunately, all were blocked by the Xuanyuan Supreme.

In terms of strength, the Xuanyuan Supreme was not at all inferior to her, the most ancient Queen of the Insect Race,

Fighting desperately, the Myriad Transformation Queen even found herself at a disadvantage.

Among the several dozen Level Twelve Ultimates in the Cosmic Starry Skies, only the two Level Twelve Ultimates from the Robber Clan could make the Xuanyuan Supreme wary.

But the Ultimates of the Robber Clan, who dare not unleash their full power within the universe, run the risk of being suppressed by the will of the universe.

“It’s just a victory or defeat in a single massive war. By the next massive war, we’ll simply forbid the Galaxy Master from participating,” thought the Myriad Transformation Queen to herself.

The massive battlefield was a joint creation of several Level Twelve beings, and naturally, the rules for the massive wars were also set by these supreme beings.

Whether it’s a large-scale war or a massive one, many Level Twelve Ultimates will establish some rules, such as prohibiting the participation of the Ultimates’ avatars and so on.

A battlefield is meant to confine the destruction caused by combat within a certain range. If the avatars of supreme beings could act at will, there would be no point for the existence of a battlefield.

The skirmish between Level Twelve beings could not be contained by a battlefield; the destructive power generated would affect the entire universe.

After witnessing the strength of the Galaxy Master, the Myriad Transformation Queen had already decided to join forces with other peak races to establish new battlefield rules.

Which is to include the Galaxy Master in the list of those who are forbidden from participating.

…

“Xuanyuan, I wonder if the Level Twelve weapons of our race could be returned. Rest assured, we can exchange them with other resources,”

the Myriad Transformation Queen thought for a moment and then said.

The many Level Twelve weapons bestowed this time had all fallen into the hands of the Galaxy Master, and the Myriad Transformation Queen planned to reclaim some through regular trade channels.

“That will depend on what the Galaxy Master thinks,”

said the Xuanyuan Supreme with a smile.

To inspire human evolvers to fight on the battlefield, the Human Civilization Alliance has long established rules that all gains on the battlefield belong to the individual.

At most, the Human Civilization Association can only make suggestions, not decisions.

Even more so for the Galaxy Master, as all his gains are at his ultimate discretion.

“Galaxy Master, what do you think? You can make a request, as long as my Insect Race has it,”

the Myriad Transformation Queen looked towards Lin Yuan, her gaze soft and her tone gentle. A normal Level Eleven Perfect, even the strongest Level Eleven beings, would be unable to resist falling for it.

“I will consider it,”

Lin Yuan’s expression remained calm.

If the Insect Race offers enough resources to satisfy him, exchanging Level Twelve weapons is not impossible.

After all, Lin Yuan is just one person and cannot use so many Level Twelve weapons at the same time.

As for trading with human civilization? Over six hundred Level Twelve weapons, the Human Civilization Alliance probably cannot absorb them in a short period.

And whether the Insect Race’s retrieving these Level Twelve weapons would lead to a recovery of their foundations and pose a threat to Human Civilization…

It should really be the Insect Race that is worried, as once these six hundred-plus supreme weapons are all converted into resources needed for cultivating the “Xuanhuang Physique,” Lin Yuan estimates he could truly push it to Level Eleven Perfect.

A Level Eleven Perfect “Xuanhuang Physique,” especially with Lin Yuan’s physical body as the foundation, could allow his body to reach the Level Twelve standard.

By then, excluding the spirit, will, and rule comprehension, Lin Yuan’s physical body will also step into the realm of supreme beings.

Spirit, will, rule comprehension, physical body—all at the level of supreme beings.

“Consider?” The Myriad Transformation Queen fell silent for a while, then her form disappeared as she returned to the Nightmare Hall.

The Insect Race’s strongest Level Eleven being below looked at Lin Yuan with complicated expressions, then turned and left without hesitation.

Since the inception of the universe, even the strongest Level Eleven beings have been tremulous in the face of Level Twelve, including the Mother of the Tree Realm and the Four Divine Kings at their peak times.

But the Galaxy Master showed no fear, and while certainly the Human Civilization Alliance played a supporting role, the Galaxy Master’s own strength was also key.

…

With the withdrawal of the Insect Race from the massive war, the Level Twelve Ultimates from other peak races exchanged glances, then made their decisions one after another.
